tools.name: identify_establishment(image_patch: ImagePatch, sign_name: str) -> str
tools.description:
def identify_establishment(image_patch: ImagePatch, sign_name: str) -> str:
    '''Identify the type of establishment represented by a given sign.
    
    Args:
        image_patch (ImagePatch): The image patch to check.
        sign_name (str): The name of the sign to identify the establishment.
       
    Returns:
        str: The type of establishment if the sign is detected, "no {sign_name} sign detected" otherwise.
    '''
    sign_patches = image_patch.find(sign_name)
    if sign_patches: 
        establishment = sign_patches[0].simple_query(f"What kind of establishment is this?")

tools.name: find_total_cost(upfront_payment, upfront_percentage)
tools.description:
def find_total_cost(upfront_payment, upfront_percentage):
    """
    Find the total cost of an item based on the upfront payment and the percentage of the total cost that the upfront payment represents.

    Parameters:
    upfront_payment (float): The amount of money paid upfront.
    upfront_percentage (float): The percentage of the total cost that the upfront payment represents, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 10% would be 0.1).

    Returns:
    float: The total cost of the item.
    """
    total_cost = upfront_payment / upfront_percentage
    return total_cost
